Mortgage Affordability Calculator

If you're about to start viewing properties, it's worth knowing your ceiling first. That ceiling is what a lender will actually offer you, and they work it out from your income before tax and what you're already committed to paying each month. Put your numbers in below for a rough idea of where it sits.
blocks.2:
How do UK lenders calculate affordability?

Some years ago the rules on mortgage lending were tightened, in a reform called the Mortgage Market Review. Since then, banks have had to check properly what you can afford, not just what you earn. They'll generally cap borrowing at 4.5 times your joint annual income, less your committed debts. Three things drive the answer.

  • Gross Income: What you earn in a year before tax comes out.
  • Committed Expenditure: The repayments that carry on regardless, like card debt, car finance and student loans.
  • Stress Testing: Lenders check you could still pay if interest rates rose sharply.
